args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Use "Pellow Home Living (PHL)" from now on.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That title is out of date.
- Please check the saved report and update its title so it matches the new name.
- Flag any other saved reports, digests or files that still use "Covey & Lark" so they can be updated together.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia (with Bettina Kroll)
